scripts.format: cargo fmt --all && pnpm --dir sdk format && prettier --write "scripts/*.mjs" && pnpm --dir packages/observer-ui format
scripts.format:check: cargo fmt --all -- --check && pnpm --dir sdk format:check && prettier --check "scripts/*.mjs" && pnpm --dir packages/observer-ui format:check
scripts.test: pnpm --dir packages/observer-ui test && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && cargo test --locked --no-fail-fast && pnpm --dir sdk test
